keys_count.description: Number of keys to generate per pad. Corresponds to -nnkeys.

key_length.description: Length of each key in characters. Corresponds to -cchars, -ddigits, -lchars.

key_type.description: Type of characters for keys. 'uppercase' for -c, 'digits' for -d, 'lowercase' for -l.

english_style.description: Use English digraph statistics for keys (easier to read). Corresponds to -e flag.

separator_interval.description: Insert hyphen separator every n characters. Corresponds to -snchars.

line_length.description: Maximum line length for output. Corresponds to -wlinelen.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Corresponds to -rseed.

signature_file.description: Path to write MD5 signatures for verification. Corresponds to -msigfile.

users.description: List of pad configurations or users to process. Items must contain name and output_file.

items.description: Internal schema definition for list items. Not used directly in values.
